bug_semantics: convert_gguf_to_hf_tokenizer (historically convert_ggml_to_hf_tokenizer) reads untrusted GGUF metadata tokenizer.ggml.eos_token_id (required) and optional bos_token_id/unknown_token_id, then uses those u32 values as Vec indices into the tokenizer vocabulary (tokens[id as usize]) with no check against tokens.len(). A crafted GGUF (1-token vocab, eos_token_id=u32::MAX) panics during model load (Rust index-out-of-bounds abort / DoS). Secondary copies of the same index live in unigram_tokenizer/bpe_tokenizer special-token registration.
